skills.name: goose-context
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep Goose config, Context7, and skills available in the guest.
skills.description: Keeps Goose configuration, Context7, and global and repository skill routing available in the guest. Use when Goose loses its config, misses a skill, or lacks Context7.

skills.name: hive-runtime
skills.one_line_purpose: Operate inside Hive's tmux, token, and cooldown constraints.
skills.description: Explains Hive's tmux session, prompt and output contract, contributor credentials, token lifetime, cooldown, and exclusive task selection. Use when operating or debugging a session.

skills.name: hive-triage
skills.one_line_purpose: Diagnose why an attached contributor is never handed work.
skills.description: Diagnoses a contributor that connects but receives no assignment without adding client-side selection or retry behavior. Use when a ready contributor remains idle.

skills.name: mcp-app
skills.one_line_purpose: Build read-only Goose Desktop MCP Apps as typed UI resources.
skills.description: Builds a stateless Goose Desktop MCP App resource with a server-only data boundary. Use when adding a Goose Desktop panel, dashboard, or interactive MCP resource.

skills.name: image-build
skills.one_line_purpose: Derive and pin the review contributor image safely.
skills.description: Maintains the pinned FSDK-derived contributor image, Hive runtime, Goose configuration, and generated skills. Use when editing image layers, pins, or image publication behavior.

skills.name: launcher
skills.one_line_purpose: Change review just recipes without breaking foreground.
skills.description: Maintains the three foreground review recipes, VM and container-only launch paths, and credential boundaries. Use when editing justfile.

skills.name: static-pr-queue
skills.one_line_purpose: Publish a safe, static queue of public pull requests.
skills.description: Publishes the public static PR queue without creating queue authority. Use when changing queue generation, ranking, artifacts, or refresh automation.

skills.name: pr-workflow
skills.one_line_purpose: Open review pull requests that merge cleanly.
skills.description: Defines protected-branch pull request, branch, title, trailer, and validation requirements. Use before branching, committing, or opening a review pull request.
